title: Sieve of Eratosthenes Visualizer
description: Watch the classic sieve cross out composites step by step on an animated grid, with primes highlighted.
howto: Press Run to animate, or Step to advance manually.
Green cells are the primes found up to N.

faqs.a: Take the smallest uncrossed number p, mark it prime, and cross out its multiples starting at p² — repeat until p² > N.
Smaller multiples of p were already crossed out by smaller primes, so p² is the first new one.
Every uncrossed number from 2 to N — exactly the primes, listed below the grid.
